penalty: dimensionlessly scaled mean squared second derivative of log(F_NP) over 0.1 <= bT <= 3.0

calibration.method: finite-difference estimate on the three polished FNP grids
calibration.interpretation: lambda=1e-6 initially contributes roughly 0.0023--0.0051 objective per row; lambda=1e-5 contributes roughly 0.023--0.051 per row. The completed D020_E772 pilots through 3e-5 reduced measured roughness by only about 3%, so an upward extension through 3e-3 is required to locate the actual fit-quality/roughness knee.

selection_rule: advance the weakest strength that preserves unregularized fit quality and passes stationary three-start FNP stability; do not select by band width alone
